messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate in us-west1. Alert: increased tail latency (streaming stalls). Affected: hosted API + some Dedicated pools. Pager: @alice (oncall).

pagerduty: Triggers: p99 >= 2s for 5m, error rate stable. Route: router-lb-us-west1.

alice: ack - looking. opening triage thread. any region-wide deploys in last 6h?

carla: not that I'm aware of. there was a routing-policy tweak rolled out ~2h ago to improve locality: commit abc123 (region-fanout-optimizations).

bob: seeing p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~600ms, p99 ~2.5s on the dashboard. streaming stalls (clients get partial chunks then reconnect). logs show increased "route_miss" and "shard_busy" from certain router instances.

dinesh: grabbing router logs, looks like hot shard on hash range 0x1a..0x2f. KV cache hit rate dropped ~20% for that range. possible hot partition + misroute.

alice: action plan: 1) identify policy change causing uneven weight, 2) if confirmed, rollback policy, 3) put temporary traffic steering to spare region or enable eager fallback for streaming. I'll handoff to @bob for live mitigation.

bob: on it. testing command to inspect routing weights: 
```
redwoodctl router get-policy --name region-fanout-optimizations --env us-west1
```

bob: output shows an unexpected weight override for shard group 7 -> weight 0.9 (should be 0.1). looks like tie-breaker bug in policy merge.

carla: that matches the hot partition. commit abc123 accidentally promoted shard weights for group7 during policy merge.

bob: immediate mitigation: patch policy to set group7 weight back to 0.1 and trigger graceful rebalance. applying now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: router-policy-update 1876007942 by bob.

bob: patch applied. I also increased routing fallback threshold to prefer cross-region fallback for streaming requests for 10 minutes: 
```
redwoodctl router set-fallback --profile streaming --threshold 300ms --prefer-region us-east1
```

alice: good. also temporarily added route throttling for noisy API keys to reduce hot shard saturation: set rate limit to 10rps for top 5 keys.

carla: metrics: p95 -> 220ms within 90s of patch, p99 -> 800ms and trending down. stream stall errors dropped from 4.2% -> 1.1%.

dinesh: checking router handoffs: we saw a long queue on a few LB instances due to an older sticky-hash codepath that didn't honor the fallback. that codepath didn't get the new weights, causing uneven load.

eve: any customer-facing impact? CS reports a few users in EMEA saw streaming stalls and reconnects (tickets 7891, 7892). no data loss, sessions resumed.

alice: customer impact note: degraded streaming latency for some sessions in us-west1 and EU gateways between 15:12-15:29 UTC. p99 peaked ~2.7s. affected customers mostly high-throughput real-time agents. patch rolled at 15:14, full mitigation by 15:28.

bob: follow-up tasks: 1) revert problematic policy merge logic (owner: carla), 2) add canary checks for shard weight spikes in CI (owner: dinesh), 3) increase observability: per-shard cache hit dashboards + alert when skew > x%. I'll file tickets.

carla: filing PR to revert merge logic now. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4321. I'll also add unit test for merge tie-breaker.

dinesh: opened infra ticket INF-1224 for canary + alerting.

alice: oncall handoff: I need to go for a scheduled break. handing to @eve (secondary oncall) at 15:35 UTC. eve, please monitor p99 for the next 2 hours and own comms.

eve: ack, taking over. I'll keep an eye on SLOs and CS queue.

bob: confirmed routing-policy rollback completed and weight normalized. queue lengths back to baseline. keeping a 10-min watch window.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: router-policy-update 1876007942.

carla: PR merged to revert merge logic and added unit tests. commit def456. also added safer merge Checks to avoid overriding explicit weights.

alice: closing summary for postmortem: root cause = policy-merge tie-breaker bug that amplified weights for shard group7 -> hot partition and misrouting + older sticky-hash codepath that bypassed fallback. impact = p95/p99 spike, streaming stalls for ~17m, customer tickets for EMEA. mitigation = rollback patch, adjust fallback, rate-limit noisy keys. action items assigned.

dinesh: scheduling postmortem doc + RCA, will include timelines and metric charts.

eve: will notify CS + outbound comms team with timeline.

alice: thanks all. leaving thread in eve's hands. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (monitoring). Closing alerts at 15:50 UTC.
